# FlareTextField

`Flare.Components.FlareTextField`

A single-line text field. Convenience over FlareField for the common string case: it is FlareField<string> under a non-generic name, so you can write <FlareTextField Label="Name" @bind-Value="name" /> without the TValue="string" noise. For non-string values (numbers, dates, custom types) use the typed FlareField or a dedicated field (FlareNumericField, pickers, ...).
